abort.unique_id_mismatch: This key belongs to a different ecosmart account than the one set up here. Enter a key from the same account, or add the other account as a new entry.

error.no_icps: This key has no connection points yet. Keys can be created before a switch to ecosmart completes; try again once your property is connected.
error.rate_limited: This key is out of requests for the moment. The allowance refills continuously, so wait a minute and try again.

reauth_confirm.description: The ecosmart API key stopped working. This usually means a new key was created in the ecosmart app, which disables the previous one. Enter the current key for the same account.

data_description.api_key: Create a key in the ecosmart app under More > Settings > Advanced > API keys. Creating a new key disables the previous one, so if you use your key somewhere else already, that other tool will stop working.

user.description: Enter the API key for your ecosmart account.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the ecosmart API

forecast_rate_limited.message: The ecosmart API key is out of requests; try again in {retry_after} seconds

icp_not_on_key.message: The ecosmart API key no longer covers connection point {icp}

invalid_auth.message: The ecosmart API key was rejected. Creating a new key in the ecosmart app disables the previous one.

invalid_device.message: Device {device_id} is not an ecosmart connection point

rate_limited.message: The ecosmart API key is out of requests; waiting at least {retry_after} seconds before trying again
